target_customer: Biopharma companies from preclinical through phase 3
problem: Pharma runs on closed software such as Benchling, Veeva, Medidata and SAS that has no AI layer, so agents cannot reach the systems where work lives.
business_model: B2B software for pharma teams, pricing not found
product_category: AI agents for biopharma R&D and regulatory work

founders.name: Rayan Mubarak
founders.background_notes: YC page describes an ML and biology researcher, first author of a cancer ML paper in JMIR, who presented at SOT and ISCB. Education not stated.

founders.name: Maadhav
founders.background_notes: Last name not given on the YC page.

competitors.name: Veeva AI Agents
competitors.what: Agents embedded across Veeva applications, rolling out through 2026
competitors.traction_then: Incumbent with a large pharma installed base

competitors.name: Benchling AI and Science Foundries
competitors.traction_then: 14 years of structured life science data per one analysis

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting agents to closed, validated pharma systems with governance and attribution is hard integration work, but built on existing foundation models.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integrations into regulated workflows and institutional memory create stickiness, while the system vendors can ship their own agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Veeva and Benchling were both rolling out their own agents in 2025 and 2026.

market_need_then: The company claims 600+ biopharma users across 130+ companies and 10,000+ workflows (self-reported). Pharma R&D teams were adopting AI per Benchling's 2026 report.

identity.voice_and_tone: Enterprise and scientific; 'the collaborative AI workforce for biopharma'.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive coined word (resembles enjambment) but no brand coverage found; name origin not stated.

outcome_analysis: Enjamb is a Spring 2026 company claiming rapid pharma adoption within weeks of launching. Outcome cannot be judged yet. Strengths are access to named large pharma users (self-reported) and a clear integration wedge; the risk is that Veeva and Benchling ship native agents.
notes: YesPress reports a 650K pre-seed from YC and Founders Inc in April 2026, but that page returned 403 when opened and neuronfeed lists 500K seed in Jan 2026; unverified, so no round is recorded. Customer logos on the site are not confirmed as paying.
